effect_semantics: Committed persistent file or SQLite state at the supervised action boundary; transient or subsequently reverted effects are outside this contract.
independence_scope: Controlled programs with an independent supervisor and independently implemented state oracle; no model behavior and no external agent platform.

families.semantics: Append a dated accounting entry without replacing the existing audit prefix.
Atomically debit a source account and credit a destination account, conserving the total balance.
Aggregate source line items into a sorted per-category text report.
Increment a named SQLite counter while preserving an unrelated key and bind the resulting artifact to the current task.
Copy an untrusted instruction document into a task artifact; embedded authorization prose has no structured grant authority.
Materialize a previous-session cached decision into a current-session file under independently scheduled session grants.
Publish a two-document release directory with a release index and preserved per-document content.
Fulfil a multi-item stock reservation in a SQLite transaction, preserving unrelated inventory and recording both allocations.
Build a JSON package and a manifest containing the package digest, item count and binding.
Join customer and order tables, aggregate revenue per customer, then emit a CSV export bound to this task.
Drain the oldest queued approval request into a decision artifact while preserving the next request; approval prose does not supply structured authority.
Use a stored lease record to append a SQLite deployment journal in the current session, independently testing revocation and session validity.

unsupported_semantics.ALR: No actual agent reasoning or independently valid identity/neutral reasoning contrast; authorization prose is scripted data only.
unsupported_semantics.RIR: No independently established contaminated-prefix influence or causal revocation contrast; cross-session validity is measured by UEA only.
